title: 03. Agents from Scratch: The Internal Decision Flow
summary: The Internal Decision Flow: explanations and runnable examples.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              LLM INTERNAL DECISION PROCESS               │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                          │
│  SYSTEM PROMPT:                                          │
│  "You are an assistant. You have these tools: [...]"    │
│                                                          │
│  USER MESSAGE:                                           │
│  "What's the weather in Paris?"                          │
│                                                          │
│  LLM REASONING (internal, invisible):                    │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐            │
│  │ "Can I answer from my training data?    │            │
│  │  No - weather changes every minute      │            │
│  │  Do I have a tool for this?             │            │
│  │  Yes - get_weather                      │            │
│  │  What parameters do I need?             │            │
│  │  city = 'Paris'                         │            │
│  │  unit = not specified, use default      │            │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────┘            │
│                                                          │
│  LLM OUTPUT (structured):                               │
│  {                                                       │
│    "tool_calls": [{                                      │
│      "id": "call_abc123",                               │
│      "type": "function",                                │
│      "function": {                                       │
│        "name": "get_weather",                           │
│        "arguments": "{\"city\": \"Paris\"}"             │
│      }                                                   │
│    }]                                                    │
│  }                                                       │
│                                                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
